His son then remotely rerouted the car – which had FSD Supervised enabled – to the nearest hospital & let them know the vehicle was en route. ER staff were standing by on arrival.

Doctors later confirmed the quick reroute likely saved his life.

Starlink Mobile is now providing data in Ukraine with @TwiyKyivstar @VeonGroup, enabling millions of people to stay connected using voice and video notes, navigation and more over apps 🛰️📱


VEON (@VEONGroup)

Out of coverage no longer means out of touch 📱🛰️

Kyivstar customers in Ukraine can now access satellite-ready apps, even where there is no terrestrial coverage or during prolonged power outages - helping people stay connected when it matters most.

Automatically switching to satellite data when the terrestrial network is unavailable, compatible smartphones can now use Viber, WhatsApp and Google Maps with data connectivity from Starlink Mobile.

Kyivstar plans to add support for more apps as they are adapted, helping to keep people connected and businesses operating, and boosting the country's resilience.

NEWS: Two years ago, an internal document from the Center for Countering Digital Hate listed "K*ll Musk's Twitter" and "Trigger EU & UK regulatory action" as annual priorities.

CCDH was co-founded by Morgan McSweeney, who later became UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer's Chief of Staff.

This week, Starmer threatened to remove X's right to self regulate.

UK regulator Ofcom opened a formal investigation into X over Grok.

Ofcom can fine X up to 10% of its worldwide revenue or block X in the UK entirely.

Starmer also announced this week a UK ban on under 16s using social media including X by spring 2027.

The 2024 documents were published by journalists Paul Thacker and Matt Taibbi.
